evidence.detail: Per-field per-unit presence over items (103) and work_units (2007). On items, 11 of 19 mandated fields are keys on 0/103 units and exist only in catalogue defaults. work_units stamp all 19 semantically (assignment/target via documented aliases).

Deleting the entire defaults block from a mini catalog, then invoking validate.py with --no-require-complete (historical CI shape, isolated so REACH-6 cannot mask V-FIELDS), still exits 0 with no V-FIELDS. The new checker, invoked bare, rejects a catalog whose 11 fields exist only in defaults even while that defaults block remains.
